glue_product: wood glue ('colle à bois'; the glue in the photo of the 2018-19 materials, myb_main Fig. 2, is Pattex Bois-Hout Express)
notes: Rouge team report 2019 (myb_rouge.pdf, ch. 3 section 4, report pp. 12-13 = PDF pp. 19-20, Fig. 3.6 and 3.7): two sticks glued over '1/3 de surface de collage' and pulled apart in an Instron 3369; 'la colle se casse et non le bois'. One specimen: the only lap in the six team reports with both a load and a glue-line failure. overlap_mm is derived, not stated: 1/3 of 114 mm (the 2018-19 mean stick length, jaune Table 1); width_mm the 2018-19 mean width. Fig. 3.7 contradicts the text: its legend gives overlaps of 2.5, 3.5 and 5 cm, its curve near 1700 N (peak about 1760 N, read from the figure) is the 5 cm one and its 3.5 cm curve peaks at about 1330 N; if the figure is right this lap is 50 mm (3.5 MPa average shear instead of 4.7). Sticks dyed red; sanding, clamping, cure time and loading rate not stated; the report says its grips make these results 'pas très fiables'
